part: Mathlib formalization: Bauer-Fike and the residual forms of E-02 (non-Hermitian eigenproblems)
statement_source: docs/proofs/E-02_non_hermitian.md of the code repository, commit 167940a on branch track/non-hermitian (from dev/3.2 at fa86456); not yet in sources/archive_v5

build.warnings: two notes that BauerFike.lean imports Mathlib modules designed for the module system; no other warning

level_K_check.method: text search of CertifyMathlib/NonHermitian/BauerFike.lean, CertifyMathlib/NonHermitian.lean and Drafts/NonHermitian/PrintAxioms.lean (run_checks.ps1, step textsearch)

second_checker.tool: nanoda (nanoda_bin of toolchain lean-4.35.0-windows, input from leanexport)
second_checker.command: leanexport <module> -- <theorem> > export.ndjson; nanoda_bin config.json (permitted_axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound; unpermitted_axiom_hard_error, nat_extension, string_extension true)
second_checker.procedure: one theorem per run; the export contains the theorem and every declaration it depends on, including the Lean core and Mathlib declarations; a run is stopped when a process exceeds 4096 MiB of private memory or 1800 s; the export file is removed after each run
